lead.description: the derivation of a probability distribution for unknowns from a joint model and the observed data

self_checks.title: Two unaffected sons
self_checks.prompt: Prior probability 1/2 of being a carrier, likelihood 1/4 if a carrier and 1 if not, for two unaffected sons. What is the posterior probability of being a carrier?

self_checks.title: A third unaffected son
self_checks.prompt: Starting from posterior probability 1/5, a third son is unaffected, with conditional probability 1/2 if a carrier and 1 if not. What is the new posterior probability?

overview_sentence: [Bayesian inference](articles/bayesian-inference.qmd) derives a probability distribution for unknowns from a joint model and the observed data.
